shared_elements: low-relief figures on a slab/pillar surface
registers or horizontal bands dividing the field
a row of repeated similar elements along the top
a raised border/frame around the scene
justification: Both are upright slabs bearing low-relief scenes organised into horizontal registers with a row of repeated small elements across the top and profile figures below, and both include a round disc-like motif, but these are generic compositional conventions. A shows animal/creature forms (quadrupeds, birds, a snake-like body) with no human worshipping scene, while B shows two anthropomorphic figures facing one another across a central axis with staffs and script-like signs, plus an arched canopy frame absent from A; the drawing conventions (blocky animal silhouettes vs. slender striding human bodies with headdresses) differ markedly.
